stories.title: No queremos conflicto político con gobierno de Jalisco por crisis de agua: Sheinbaum; cuestiona esquema que busca aplicar Lemus

en.title: We do not want political conflict with Jalisco government over water crisis: Sheinbaum; questions scheme that Lemus seeks to apply
en.summary: Mexico's President expressed concern about water quality problems affecting residents in the Guadalajara metropolitan area and questioned the approach being proposed by the Jalisco governor.

stories.title: Sheinbaum no habló sobre Academia Policial en encuentro con embajador Johnson; reitera se deben cumplir leyes mexicanas

en.title: Sheinbaum did not speak about Police Academy in meeting with Ambassador Johnson; reiterates Mexican laws must be complied with
en.summary: During a meeting with the U.S. ambassador, Mexico's President did not address the Police Academy matter and stressed the importance of following Mexican laws.

stories.title: Winnow: Lanzan solución de IA que predice cuánto cocinar, creada con chefs de Hilton

en.title: Winnow: Launch AI solution that predicts how much to cook, created with Hilton chefs
en.summary: Winnow and Hilton introduced an artificial intelligence tool designed to forecast cooking quantities, building on their partnership that has prevented significant food waste and carbon emissions.

stories.title: Detienen a adolescente por disparar con escopeta en escuela secundaria de Francia; deja herido al director y a profesora

en.title: Teenager detained for shooting with shotgun at secondary school in France; leaves director and teacher wounded
en.summary: A student at a French secondary school opened fire with a shotgun, injuring the school director and a teacher, with authorities reporting the shooter had no prior history of crime or radicalization.

stories.title: Lemus debe explicar uso de agua y gas lacrimógeno para reprimir protestas, dice Sheinbaum; se opone a privatización del servicio

en.title: Lemus must explain use of water and tear gas to suppress protests, says Sheinbaum; opposes service privatization
en.summary: Mexico's president criticized former governor Enrique Alfaro for not providing resources to complete the El Zapotillo dam project and called for accountability regarding protest suppression methods.

stories.title: Reciclaje de PET en México: cómo las botellas se convierten en materia prima

en.title: PET recycling in Mexico: how bottles become raw material
en.summary: Indorama Ventures processes approximately 2.64 billion recycled plastic bottles annually in Mexico through its EcoMex division, reintroducing them into the production chain.

stories.title: Proyecto de Ley de Derechos Indígenas, sin terminar; Sheinbaum menciona que "aún hay debate" en algunos temas

en.title: Indigenous Rights Law Bill remains incomplete; Sheinbaum notes "there is still debate" on some issues
en.summary: Mexico's president announced the consultation period will be expanded before presenting the indigenous rights legislation, indicating ongoing disagreements on certain provisions.

stories.title: Sheinbaum deja a Congreso de Jalisco aprobación de financiamiento para obras de agua; "condena represión"

en.title: Sheinbaum leaves approval of water works financing to Jalisco Congress; "condemns repression"
en.summary: Mexico's president stated that Jalisco's Congress must decide whether to approve the governor's financing plan for water infrastructure in the Guadalajara metropolitan area.

stories.title: Trabajadores del IMSS alistan movilización nacional para el 13 y 14 de octubre

en.title: IMSS Workers Prepare National Mobilization for October 13 and 14
en.summary: Mexican Social Security Institute workers plan to protest on October 13-14 demanding higher wages, better working conditions, and a change in union leadership.

stories.title: Registran casa de representante Ilhan Omar por presunta investigación penal; inspección fue por agentes de Investigaciones de Seguridad Nacional

en.title: House Searched in Investigation Related to Representative Ilhan Omar; Inspection Conducted by National Security Investigators
en.summary: Federal agents searched a residence in connection with a criminal investigation allegedly involving irregularities in immigration documents submitted by Omar's father during her childhood.

stories.title: Alistan conferencia "para hablar sobre el tema del IMSS"; preparan marcha nacional

en.title: Conference Planned "to Discuss IMSS Issue"; National March Being Prepared
en.summary: A conference is being organized to address issues related to Mexico's social security institute, with a national march in preparation.

stories.title: Registran casa de Ilhan Omar, representante demócrata

en.title: House of Ilhan Omar, Democratic Representative, Searched
en.summary: U.S. federal agents conducted a search of Democratic congresswoman Ilhan Omar's residence as part of a criminal investigation.

stories.title: ¿Por qué Tiendas 3B vende tan barato y sigue ganando millones? El secreto del "Hard Discount"

en.title: Why does Tiendas 3B sell so cheaply and continue earning millions? The secret of "Hard Discount"
en.summary: Tiendas 3B's profitability strategy relies partly on concentrated store locations in nearby zones, which streamlines supply distribution and reduces delivery route costs.

stories.title: ¿Dejaste una prenda en Monte de Piedad? Esta es la fecha límite para recuperarla

en.title: Did you leave an item at Monte de Piedad? This is the deadline to recover it
en.summary: Some customers have extended time to regularize their contracts following a strike, though deadline dates vary among different individuals.
